text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Namibian farmworkers are calling for a minimum wage and the formation of a permanent official body to investigate farm labourers' terms and conditions. These were among the submissions handed to a government commission probing working conditions of farm and domestic workers by the Namibia Farm Workers Union (Nafwu) on Friday.

- National Assembly speaker, Mose Tjitendero, has called on the government, political parties and non-governmental organisations to make women aware of their rights and to encourage them to contribute to their own development.
